definitions: A piece of meat that has been roasted or is suitable for roasting.
A social occasion at which food is roasted and eaten, typically outdoors.
A severe public criticism or a humorous tribute in which a person is subjected to a series of jokes and good-natured insults.
examples: We had a delicious roast for Sunday lunch.
They invited us to a beach roast.
The comedian delivered a hilarious roast of the guest of honour.
